notes: mem0ai 2.2.1 Memory.from_config: OpenAI llm (the run's answer model, mem0's own sampling defaults), OpenAI embedder (the run's embedding model), Qdrant collection ledgerbench_standard_luna_allfour. One user_id per user; each message added on its own as a 'user' turn with '[weekday date]' in the text, metadata session_date and weekday, infer=True, and the session date passed as add(prompt=...) so the extractor resolves relative dates against it. Answering: search(top_k=30) on the question's text, memories listed with their day, the shared answer prompt. Ingestion and search usage metered by patching the OpenAI SDK.
